summary.para: Tracks adaptive music plans and switches their room, combat, and victory tracks in response to run lifecycle events.
跟踪自适应音乐方案，并响应跑局生命周期事件切换其房间、战斗和胜利曲目。
Gets the shared adaptive music director.
获取共享的自适应音乐调度器。
Disposes this director's lifecycle subscriptions without stopping or detaching its currently tracked handles.
释放此调度器的生命周期订阅，但不会停止或分离当前跟踪的句柄。
Attaches an adaptive plan, immediately applies its room state, and returns its controlling handle.
附加自适应方案，立即应用其房间状态，并返回控制该方案的句柄。

param.name: plan
param.para: The lifecycle-driven music plan to track.
要跟踪的生命周期驱动音乐方案。

returns.para: A handle that can stop the current override or dispose the attachment.
可停止当前覆盖或释放该附加关系的句柄。

summary.para: Removes a handle from lifecycle tracking without stopping its current music.
从生命周期跟踪中移除句柄，但不停止其当前音乐。

param.name: handle
param.para: The handle to detach.
要分离的句柄。

summary.para: Controls one adaptive music-plan attachment and the music handle currently selected for it.
控制一个自适应音乐方案附加关系及其当前选中的音乐句柄。
Stops the current override, applies the plan's stop-restoration policy, and permanently detaches this handle from the shared director.
停止当前覆盖，应用方案的停止恢复策略，并将此句柄永久从共享调度器中分离。
Stops the current override without detaching the plan, allowing a later lifecycle event to start it again.
停止当前覆盖但不分离方案，因此后续生命周期事件仍可再次启动该方案。

param.name: restoreVanillaMusic
param.para: Whether to request restoration of run music when the plan's policy permits it.
在方案的 策略允许时，是否请求恢复跑局音乐。

summary.para: Defines the room, combat, and victory music states driven by .
定义由 驱动的房间、战斗和胜利音乐状态。
Gets or initializes the music source applied when room state is refreshed outside combat.
获取或初始化在非战斗房间状态刷新时应用的音乐源。
Gets or initializes the music source applied when combat starts.
获取或初始化战斗开始时应用的音乐源。
Gets or initializes the optional music source applied when combat victory is reported.
获取或初始化战斗胜利事件发生时应用的可选音乐源。
Gets or initializes whether a stop request may refresh the game's normal run music.
获取或初始化停止请求是否可以刷新游戏的正常跑局音乐。
Gets or initializes whether combat end stops the adaptive override instead of returning to . Normal run music is refreshed only when is also enabled.
获取或初始化战斗结束时是否停止自适应覆盖，而不是返回 。 仅当 也启用时才会刷新正常跑局音乐。
Gets or initializes whether room-state refreshes update the game's normal track and ambience when is absent.
获取或初始化在缺少 时，房间状态刷新是否更新游戏的正常曲目和环境音。
Gets or initializes the playback options used to start .
获取或初始化启动 时使用的播放选项。
Gets or initializes the playback options used to start .
获取或初始化启动 时使用的播放选项。
Gets or initializes the playback options used to start .
获取或初始化启动 时使用的播放选项。
Provides factory methods for common adaptive music-plan patterns.
提供常见自适应音乐方案模式的工厂方法。
Creates a combat override with optional room and victory sources and caller-supplied playback options.
创建战斗音乐覆盖，并可指定房间与胜利音乐源以及调用方提供的播放选项。

param.name: combatSource
param.para: The music source applied when combat starts.
战斗开始时应用的音乐源。

param.name: roomSource
param.para: The optional source applied outside combat; when absent, normal room music is refreshed.
在战斗外应用的可选音乐源；未提供时会刷新正常房间音乐。

param.name: victorySource
param.para: The optional source applied after combat victory.
战斗胜利后应用的可选音乐源。

param.name: combatOptions
param.para: The combat playback options, or null to use combat-scoped defaults.
战斗播放选项；为 时使用战斗作用域默认值。

param.name: roomOptions
param.para: The room playback options, or null to use room-scoped defaults.
房间播放选项；为 时使用房间作用域默认值。

param.name: victoryOptions
param.para: The victory playback options, or null to use combat-scoped defaults.
胜利播放选项；为 时使用战斗作用域默认值。

returns.para: The configured adaptive music plan.
配置完成的自适应音乐方案。

summary.para: Creates a run-wide room and combat override that returns to its room source after combat.
创建覆盖整场跑局房间与战斗音乐，并在战斗后返回其房间音乐源的方案。

param.name: roomSource
param.para: The music source applied outside combat.
在战斗外应用的音乐源。

param.name: combatSource
param.para: The music source applied when combat starts.
战斗开始时应用的音乐源。

param.name: victorySource
param.para: The optional source applied after combat victory.
战斗胜利后应用的可选音乐源。

returns.para: The configured adaptive music plan.
配置完成的自适应音乐方案。

summary.para: Specifies how a named audio channel handles a claim while another handle owns it.
指定已有句柄占用命名音频通道时如何处理新的占用请求。
Keeps the current owner and rejects the new claim.
保留当前占用者并拒绝新的占用请求。
Stops and releases the current owner, replacing it only when release succeeds.
停止并释放当前占用者，并且仅在释放成功时用新句柄替换。
Tracks case-sensitive named channels and tag groups for playback replacement and bulk stop operations.
跟踪区分大小写的命名通道和标签组，用于替换播放与批量停止操作。
Gets the shared channel and tag registry.
获取共享的通道与标签注册表。
Attempts to assign a handle to a named channel according to the requested collision policy.
按照指定的冲突策略尝试将句柄分配到命名通道。

param.name: channel
param.para: The case-sensitive channel name.
区分大小写的通道名称。

param.name: handle
param.para: The handle that should own the channel.
应占用该通道的句柄。

param.name: mode
param.para: How to handle an existing owner.
已有占用者的处理方式。

param.name: allowFadeOut
param.para: Whether a replaced owner may fade out when stopped.
停止被替换的占用者时是否允许淡出。

returns.para: when the handle already owns or successfully claims the channel; when an existing owner is kept.
句柄已占用或成功占用该通道时为 ；保留已有占用者时为 。

summary.para: Removes a handle from every named channel it currently owns without stopping it.
从该句柄当前占用的所有命名通道中移除它，但不停止播放。

param.name: handle
param.para: The channel owner to remove.
要移除的通道占用者。

summary.para: Adds a handle by reference identity to a tag group for later bulk stopping.
按引用标识将句柄添加到标签组，以便之后批量停止。

param.name: tag
param.para: The case-sensitive tag name.
区分大小写的标签名称。

param.name: handle
param.para: The handle to add.
要添加的句柄。

summary.para: Removes a handle from all tracked channels and tag groups without stopping it.
从所有跟踪的通道和标签组中移除句柄，但不停止播放。

param.name: handle
param.para: The handle to detach.
要分离的句柄。

summary.para: Attempts to stop and release every handle in a tag group, retaining entries whose release fails.
尝试停止并释放标签组中的所有句柄，并保留释放失败的条目。

param.name: tag
param.para: The case-sensitive tag name.
区分大小写的标签名称。

param.name: allowFadeOut
param.para: Whether stopped handles may fade out.
停止句柄时是否允许淡出。

returns.para: when at least one handle was found and every release completed; otherwise .
找到至少一个句柄且所有释放均已完成时为 ；否则为 。

summary.para: Attempts to stop and release the handle assigned to a named channel, removing it only when release succeeds.
尝试停止并释放分配到命名通道的句柄，并且仅在释放成功时移除它。

param.name: channel
param.para: The case-sensitive channel name.
区分大小写的通道名称。

param.name: allowFadeOut
param.para: Whether the stopped handle may fade out.
停止句柄时是否允许淡出。

returns.para: when an assigned handle was found and released; otherwise .
找到并成功释放已分配句柄时为 ；否则为 。

summary.para: Tracks audio handles by built-in lifecycle scope or manual token and cleans them up at matching lifecycle boundaries.

summary.para: Loads loose audio files through the FMOD add-on, creates paused sound or streaming-music instances, and tracks successfully loaded paths for deterministic unload.

remarks.para: Accepted inputs are existing absolute paths, globalized user:// paths, and res:// files visible to . Packed or imported Godot audio resources must use a resource-specific method, which materializes standard WAV, Ogg Vorbis, or MP3 data into a private cache with ASCII virtual paths. Compressed WAV resources are decoded to PCM. Raw files and decoded output are limited to 256 MiB; WAV decoding is limited to 600 seconds. Dynamic audio streams are unsupported. Non-ASCII loose-file paths are localized or copied into this cache before FMOD receives them.

可接受的输入包括现有绝对路径、全局化后的 user:// 路径，以及 可见的 res:// 文件。打包或导入的 Godot 音频资源必须使用资源专用方法，将标准 WAV、Ogg Vorbis 或 MP3 数据写入具有 ASCII 虚拟路径的私有缓存。 压缩 WAV 资源解码为 PCM。原始文件与解码结果上限为 256 MiB，WAV 解码时长上限为 600 秒，不支持动态音频流。 含非 ASCII 字符的松散文件路径会先转换为虚拟路径或复制到缓存，再传给 FMOD。

Gets whether this pile has manual-card-play capability through the base-game targeting, action queue, hand-consistent evaluation and resource payment, card hooks, and destination-pile flow. Hand identity during cost display, play validation, and payment is an invariant of this capability, not a separately selectable behavior. Play-enabled cards automatically participate in core empty-hand and playable-card queries, and are always represented by card nodes. This value also initializes for each new container. The default is . Runtime availability can temporarily disable and restore granted capability, but cannot enable a definition that disallows card play.

Registers a forced act-entry rule that selects only from the supplied weighted candidates. Equal weights give equal probabilities. The existing act is included only when explicitly supplied.
注册一条仅从指定加权候选中选择的强制章节进入规则。 相同权重对应相同概率；只有显式提供时才会包含已有章节。

remarks.para: Register before content freezes. No ordinary pool declaration is required. Each call adds an independent rule owned by this mod for the process lifetime; there is no per-run registration or removal. The array is copied, validated and ordered by type name. Candidate types must be concrete, closed act models; custom acts must also be registered as content before model initialization.
必须在内容冻结前注册，无须声明普通池。每次调用为本模组添加一条独立规则， 在进程存续期间有效，不提供每局注册或移除。候选数组会被复制、验证并按类型名排序。 候选必须是具体、封闭的章节模型类型；自定义章节还须在模型初始化前注册为内容。

At act entry, this rule competes with all single-act and candidate-set force rules. Higher priority wins; equal priorities use earlier registration. Eligibility runs once when the rule is reached, outside the registration lock, and must be deterministic and side-effect-free. False continues to the next rule; if no rule matches, ordinary pool selection runs. A winning rule draws once from the run's RNG, or does not draw for a single candidate. Losing rules do not draw or evaluate candidate weights. Exceptions propagate before act replacement. Selecting the existing act preserves its instance and still prevents lower rules and the ordinary pool.

进入章节时，此规则与所有单章节和候选集合强制规则共同竞争。 优先级较高者胜出，同优先级时先注册者胜出。检查到此规则时，条件回调在注册锁外执行一次， 必须确定且无副作用。返回 false 时继续检查下一条规则；均不命中时进入普通池。 胜出的规则使用本局随机数源抽选一次，单候选不消耗随机数；未胜出的规则不抽选或计算候选权重。 异常在替换章节前向上传播。选中已有章节时保留其实例，且仍阻止后续规则及普通池执行。

summary.para: Declares this mod's uniform contributions to a zero-based slot before content freezes. Repeating the declaration is harmless; switching this mod's mode throws. Other mods may use weighted candidates in the same slot. Uniform candidates contribute weight 1, and the existing act always has fixed weight 1.
在内容冻结前为本模组声明从零开始的槽位的均匀候选。重复声明无影响，切换本模组的模式会抛出异常。其他模组可在同一槽位使用加权候选。均匀候选与已有章节均以权重 1 参与抽选，已有章节的权重不可修改。

remarks.para: Registrations remain active for the process lifetime; there is no per-run registration or removal.

summary.para: Adds a weight-1 candidate to this mod's previously declared uniform pool before content freezes. Registering the same type twice in one mod and slot throws. Different mods' contributions for the same type merge by maximum eligible weight. Candidates matching the existing act are ignored.
在内容冻结前向本模组已声明的均匀池添加权重为 1 的候选。同一模组在同一槽位重复注册类型会抛出异常；不同模组的同类型候选取最大有效权重。与已有章节相同的候选被忽略。

remarks.para: Registrations remain active for the process lifetime; there is no per-run registration or removal.

Callbacks execute outside the registration lock in ordinal, case-insensitive mod-ID order, then ordinal type-name order. Each runs at most once per resolution, with eligibility before weight. They must be deterministic and side-effect-free; exceptions propagate before act replacement.
回调于注册锁外按模组 ID（不区分大小写）、类型名的序数顺序执行，每次解析至多执行一次，先判断条件再计算权重。回调必须确定且无副作用；异常在替换章节前向上传播。

member.remarks:

[^A-Za-z0-9]+

member.name: M:STS2RitsuLib.Content.ModContentRegistry.AcronymBoundaryRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])
Explanation:
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z] greedily at least once.
○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z].
○ Match a character in the set [a-z].

Represents RitsuLib's global JSON settings.

获取或设置迁移流程使用的持久化架构版本。
Gets or sets whether managed mod data is synchronized with the game's remote store while Steam Cloud is active.
获取或设置在 Steam 云可用时，是否将托管的模组数据与游戏的远端存储同步。
Gets or sets the master switch for debug-compatibility shims. When disabled, the individual flags are ignored and patched targets retain their original behavior.
获取或设置调试兼容适配的总开关。禁用时将忽略各子选项，补丁目标保持原有行为。
Gets or sets whether missing LocTable keys fall back to placeholders and emit one-time compatibility warnings.
获取或设置缺失的 LocTable 键是否回退到占位文本，并输出一次性的兼容性警告。
Gets or sets whether framework bridges skip invalid epoch grants and emit one-time compatibility warnings.
获取或设置框架桥接是否跳过无效的纪元授予，并输出一次性的兼容性警告。
Gets or sets whether characters registered through ModContentRegistry receive an empty THE_ARCHITECT dialogue fallback when the game resolves no dialogue.
获取或设置当游戏未解析到对话时，是否为通过 ModContentRegistry 注册的角色提供空白的 THE_ARCHITECT 对话回退。
Gets or sets whether the browser-based debug log viewer starts for this session.
获取或设置是否为当前会话启动浏览器调试日志查看器。

获取或设置启动后短时间内没有客户端连接时，是否在系统浏览器中打开查看器。
Gets or sets whether the viewer binds to all network interfaces for LAN access.
获取或设置查看器是否监听所有网络接口，以允许局域网访问。
Gets or sets the debug log viewer's HTTP port.
获取或设置调试日志查看器的 HTTP 端口。
Gets or sets how many consecutive fallback ports are tried when the preferred port is busy.
获取或设置首选端口被占用时继续尝试的连续备用端口数量。
Gets or sets the stable browser access token for the debug log viewer.
获取或设置调试日志查看器使用的稳定浏览器访问令牌。
Gets or sets the number of recent events retained for newly opened browser sessions.
获取或设置为新打开的浏览器会话保留的最近事件数量。
Gets or sets the pending-event capacity before the non-blocking debug pipeline drops new events.
获取或设置非阻塞调试流程开始丢弃新事件前的待处理事件容量。
Gets or sets whether developer-console history navigation preserves the current draft.
获取或设置开发者控制台的历史记录导航是否保留当前草稿。
Gets or sets whether developer-console autocomplete display and candidate-source enhancements are enabled.
获取或设置是否启用开发者控制台的自动补全显示与候选来源增强。
Gets or sets whether showing or hiding the developer console clears its input buffer.
获取或设置显示或隐藏开发者控制台时是否清空输入缓冲区。

Gets or sets whether RitsuLib developer tools are enabled. When enabled, the visual workspace and developer-console commands can inspect or modify supported game state. In multiplayer this controls local access; changes approved by the host are still applied so every player retains the same run state. These tools are disabled by default.
获取或设置是否启用 RitsuLib 开发者工具。启用后，可视化工作台和开发者控制台指令可以检查或修改 受支持的游戏状态。在多人模式下，此设置只控制本机入口；主机批准的修改仍会生效，使所有玩家保持 相同的对局状态。这些工具默认关闭。

Gets or sets whether a multiplayer host accepts supported state changes requested by other players. The host must also enable the developer tools, and every connected player must use a compatible RitsuLib version before a request can be accepted.
获取或设置多人游戏主机是否接受其他玩家请求的受支持状态修改。主机还必须启用开发者工具， 且每个在线玩家都必须使用兼容的 RitsuLib 版本，请求才会被接受。

Gets or sets the runtime key binding that opens the visual developer-tools workspace. The binding is ignored while developer tools are disabled. The binding changes only workspace visibility and does not enable or disable the feature.
获取或设置用于显示或关闭可视化开发者工具工作台的运行时按键绑定。开发者工具关闭时会忽略此绑定； 此按键绑定只改变工作台可见性，不会启用或禁用该功能。
Gets or sets the runtime key binding that starts direct combat-creature picking. The binding is ignored while developer tools are disabled or creature picking is unavailable.
获取或设置用于直接开始选择战斗生物的运行时按键绑定。开发者工具关闭或无法选择生物时， 此按键绑定会被忽略。

获取或设置用于打开独立模组设置中心的运行时按键绑定。
Gets or sets whether content-source hover tips are enabled.

获取或设置内容来源悬停提示如何标识模组。有效值为 name、id 和 name_and_id。
Gets or sets where a folded content-source line appears relative to the hover-tip body. Valid values are top and bottom.
获取或设置折叠到悬停提示正文中的内容来源行相对于正文的位置。有效值为 top 和 bottom；其他值在使用时回退为 top。
Gets or sets the HTML color used for content-source text. Invalid values fall back to the default purple.
获取或设置内容来源文字使用的 HTML 颜色；无效值会回退为默认紫色。
Gets or sets whether a blank line separates folded content-source text from the hover-tip body.
获取或设置折叠的内容来源文字与悬停提示正文之间是否添加一个空行。

Gets or sets the single-line content-source format. The placeholders {source}, {name}, and {id} insert the selected display style, display name, and mod ID respectively. Line breaks are converted to spaces, values are limited to 256 characters, and empty values fall back to {source}.

获取或设置最多导出的基础卡牌数量；0 表示不限制。

Gets or sets whether RitsuLib periodically checks its mirrored update manifest.

Gets or sets whether RitsuLib checks subscribed Steam Workshop items and requests downloads for installed items that require an update.

Gets or sets whether newly created main menus use bounded scrolling and focus handling. Enabled by default. Restart the game to ensure a changed value takes effect.

获取或设置通知消息相对于所选锚点的垂直像素偏移。
Gets or sets the maximum number of simultaneously visible toast notifications; overflow is queued.
获取或设置同时可见的通知消息数量上限；超出部分将进入队列。
Gets or sets the default toast display duration in seconds.
获取或设置通知消息的默认显示时长（秒）。
Gets or sets the default toast animation preset ID.
获取或设置通知消息的默认动画预设 ID。
Gets whether the master switch for RitsuLib's debug-compatibility fallbacks is enabled.

获取缺失的 LocTable 键是否使用占位文本并输出警告。

获取无效的纪元授予是否会被跳过并输出警告，而不是抛出异常。

获取已注册角色是否使用空白的 THE_ARCHITECT 对话回退。
Gets the Harmony patch-dump path and first-main-menu option.
获取 Harmony 补丁转储路径和首次进入主菜单时执行的选项。
Specifies which surrounding interface elements to include when rendering a card to PNG.
指定将卡牌渲染为 PNG 时包含哪些周边界面元素。
Includes only the NCard control, preserving the game's card frame, portrait, and text.
仅包含 NCard 控件，并保留游戏中的卡牌边框、图像和文本。
Includes the card and fixed hover-tip columns. Text tips use hover_tip.tscn, while referenced cards use scaled NCard controls.
包含卡牌和固定布局的悬停提示列。文本提示使用 hover_tip.tscn，引用的卡牌则使用缩放后的 NCard 控件。

Batch-exports registered cards through offscreen instances; it uses library models and does not require an active run. Each capture attempt releases its temporary scene subtree in a finally path, including after capture or frame-wait failures.
通过离屏 实例批量导出已注册卡牌；使用卡牌库模型，无需存在进行中的一局游戏。每次捕获尝试都会在 finally 路径中释放临时场景子树，包括捕获或等待帧失败后。
Starts the requested batch PNG export when no other card export is running.
在没有其他卡牌导出运行时启动请求的批量 PNG 导出。
Checks whether the game is loaded and card preview nodes can be instantiated.
检查游戏是否已加载且能实例化卡牌预览节点。
Provides the backward-compatible validation entry point. It always sets and to ; new code should call instead.
提供向后兼容的验证入口。它始终将 和 设为 ；新代码应改用 。
Frees a capture subtree built exclusively from non-pooled instances. Export never uses or NodePool, so teardown cannot race the in-game card pool.
释放仅由非池化 实例构成的捕获子树。导出从不使用 或 NodePool，因此拆卸不会与游戏内卡牌池发生竞争。
Instantiates card.tscn without , so export never competes with the shared NodePool.
不通过 实例化 card.tscn，因此导出绝不会与共享 NodePool 竞争。
Refreshes card visuals after the enters the scene tree.
在 进入场景树后刷新其视觉效果。
Adds a referenced-card hover column matching the in-game card tooltip.
添加与游戏内卡牌工具提示一致的引用卡牌悬停列。
Displays a full-screen blocking progress overlay during a batch card PNG export.
在批量导出卡牌 PNG 期间显示全屏阻塞式进度浮层。

Renders compendium-style relic inspection and potion-lab focus panels in an offscreen . Each capture attempt releases its temporary scene subtree in a finally path, including after capture or frame-wait failures.
在离屏 中渲染图鉴风格的遗物查看面板和药水实验室聚焦面板。每次捕获尝试都会在 finally 路径中释放临时场景子树，包括捕获或等待帧失败后。

Supplies player selection, refresh, and page navigation to a registered developer-tools page.
向已注册的开发者工具页面提供玩家选择、刷新与页面导航能力。

获取开发者工具目标控件当前选中的玩家；当前没有玩家时为 null。
Gets an immutable snapshot of players currently available to the workspace.
获取工作区当前可用玩家的不可变快照。
Schedules a workspace refresh after the current callback or UI event completes. Repeated requests before the deferred refresh runs are coalesced.
在当前回调或界面事件完成后安排一次工作区刷新；延迟刷新执行前的重复请求会被合并。

通过 modId:pageId 全局标识打开另一个当前可用的开发者工具页面。

param.name: qualifiedPageId
param.para: The qualified identity of the destination page.
目标页面的全局标识。

returns.para: when the destination is currently available and was opened; otherwise, . Opening the current page also returns .
当目标页面当前可用且已打开时返回 ，否则返回 ； 打开当前页面同样返回 。

exception.para: Thrown when is blank.
当 为空时抛出。

summary.para: Defines one independently owned page in RitsuLib's visual developer-tools dock.
定义 RitsuLib 可视化开发者工具停靠面板中的一个独立所有权页面。
Creates a page definition with required identity, title, and content factory.
使用必需的标识、标题和内容工厂创建页面定义。

param.name: modId
param.para: The owning manifest ID. It participates in the globally unique page identity.
所属模组的清单 ID；它会参与组成全局唯一页面标识。

param.name: id
param.para: The stable page ID within .
页面在 内的稳定 ID。

param.name: title
param.para: Deferred localized or literal text used by the rail and page header.
侧边栏与页面标题使用的延迟本地化文本或字面文本。

param.name: contentFactory
param.para: Creates a new, unattached control whenever the page is rebuilt. Returning null, an invalid control, or a control that already has a parent is rejected by the host.
页面重建时创建一个新的未挂载控件。返回 null、无效控件或已有父节点的控件会被宿主拒绝。

当 或 为空时抛出。

当 或 为 null 时抛出。

summary.para: Gets the owning mod manifest ID.
获取所属模组的清单 ID。

获取页面在所属模组内的稳定 ID。
Gets the globally unique ID in modId:pageId form.
获取采用 modId:pageId 格式的全局唯一 ID。
Gets the deferred localized or literal display title.
获取延迟解析的本地化或字面显示标题。
Gets the page order. Lower values appear first; values from -100,000 through 100,000 are accepted.
获取页面顺序；数值较小的页面排在前面，允许范围为 -100,000 至 100,000。
Gets the preferred fraction of viewport width used by the joined dock, from 0.35 through 0.90. The host still constrains the page to the space available beside the rail. The default is 0.62.
获取组合式停靠面板期望占用的视口宽度比例，范围为 0.35 至 0.90。宿主仍会将页面限制在侧边栏旁的 可用空间内；默认值为 0.62。

Gets an optional side-effect-free icon factory. The host accepts an existing texture up to 2,048 pixels per axis; null or invalid results use the fallback page icon. The caller retains ownership and must keep returned textures valid while the page remains registered.
获取可选且无副作用的图标工厂。宿主接受单边不超过 2,048 像素的现有纹理；返回 null 或无效结果时 使用页面回退图标。调用方仍持有返回纹理，并须在页面保持注册期间确保纹理有效。
Gets an optional visibility predicate, re-evaluated when the workspace refreshes. Exceptions hide only this page and are logged once per page instance.
获取可选可见性谓词；工作区刷新时重新求值。异常只会隐藏当前页面，并按页面实例记录一次日志。
Gets the factory that creates a fresh page control.
获取用于创建全新页面控件的工厂。
Registers independently owned pages for the visual developer-tools dock without replacing built-in or other mods' pages.
为可视化开发者工具停靠面板注册独立所有权页面，且不会替换内置页面或其他模组的页面。
Registers a page and returns an ownership handle. Disposing the handle removes only that exact registration. Duplicate qualified IDs are rejected rather than replaced.
注册页面并返回所有权句柄。释放句柄时只移除该次注册；重复的全局 ID 会被拒绝而不会覆盖原页面。

param.name: definition
param.para: The immutable page definition to validate and register.
要校验并注册的不可变页面定义。

returns.para: An idempotent handle that unregisters this page when disposed.
释放时取消注册当前页面的幂等句柄。

exception.para: Thrown when identity text is malformed, the qualified ID is reserved, or it already exists.
当标识文本格式无效、全局 ID 已保留或已存在时抛出。
Thrown when is null.
当 为 null 时抛出。
Thrown when the sort order, preferred width, or total page count exceeds its supported bound.
当排序值、期望宽度或页面总数超过支持范围时抛出。

summary.para: Returns an immutable, deterministically ordered snapshot of registered pages.
返回已注册页面的不可变确定顺序快照。

描述开发者控制台对 的调用。

创建自动补全请求的上下文。

生成补全结果的控制台命令。
The arguments preceding the token being completed.
待补全标记之前已有的参数。

待补全参数的从零开始索引。
The developer-console command name.
开发者控制台命令名称。

提供自动补全绑定注册所需的可复用谓词。
Matches the first argument when no preceding arguments are present.
匹配不存在前置参数时的第一个参数。

匹配恰有一个前置参数时的第二个参数。

匹配 relic 命令中单独使用或位于 add、remove 之后的遗物 ID。

匹配用于标识解锁条目的 unlock 尾随参数。

注册与游戏命令参数位置一致的内置自动补全绑定。

为开发者控制台的自动补全候选项附加可选的本地化后缀标签。

若 有本地化标题，则为其附加 (localized-title)。

在 的基础上启用 RitsuLib 所注册 ID 的简写匹配。
Enables complete pile-name autocomplete: mod pile IDs, localized matching and labels, RitsuLib-owned ID shorthand, and duplicate removal.
启用完整的牌堆名称自动补全：模组牌堆 ID、本地化匹配和标签、RitsuLib 所注册 ID 的简写及去重。
Allows ancient-event option tokens to be matched by an option or relic's localized title, or by the relic's entry ID.
允许按选项或遗物的本地化标题以及遗物条目 ID 匹配先古之民事件选项令牌。

将已注册的次要资源 ID 添加到候选列表中。

以括号附加本地化次要资源标题。

Whether the extra-hand pile has manual-card-play capability through the vanilla pipeline, including hand-consistent cost display, validation, and payment. Play-enabled cards automatically participate in core empty-hand and playable-card queries and are represented by card nodes. This also determines each new container's initial runtime availability. Defaults to .

When on an attribute declared on a base type, the registration is available to concrete derived types. The nearest declaration wins per logical registration slot: a direct declaration can replace inherited configuration such as a pool, count, path, placement, or threshold, while registrations for distinct target IDs or scopes remain additive.

Overrides the target type or member name for a nested wrapper class, method, or property. With , the type is resolved inside the target mod's assemblies. With , it must be an assembly-qualified CLR type name.
为嵌套包装器类、方法或属性覆盖目标类型或成员名。与 配合时，类型在目标模组的程序集中解析；与 配合时，类型必须使用程序集限定的 CLR 类型名。

Gets or sets concrete generic arguments for the target method, or for the target type on a wrapper class or property. Use the CLR type name including its arity, such as Namespace.Box`1. Arrays are copied on assignment and access. Null or empty means no specialization; at most 32 closed, non-pointer, non-byref, non-byref-like and non-void types are accepted.
获取或设置目标方法的具体泛型实参；标注包装类或属性时则用于目标类型。类型名须包含 CLR 元数， 例如 Namespace.Box`1。赋值及读取时复制数组；null 或空数组表示不指定泛型实参。最多接受 32 个 已封闭、非指针、非引用、非类引用且非 void 的类型。

remarks.para: Declare a non-generic wrapper and non-generic stub with concrete parameter and return types for each specialization. Open generic stubs are not patched. Target arity and generic constraints are checked when binding; mismatches are logged and leave that member unpatched.
每组特化使用独立的非泛型包装类和非泛型存根，参数及返回值采用具体类型；不为开放泛型存根打补丁。 绑定时校验目标元数和泛型约束；不匹配会记录日志并保留该成员原实现。

exception.para: More than 32 arguments are supplied, or an argument is null or unsupported.
实参超过 32 个，或某项为 null 或不支持的类型。

summary.para: Overrides the remote type and, optionally, the member name.
覆盖远端类型，并可选择覆盖成员名。

param.name: type
param.para: Target type name. Use a full type name with , or an assembly-qualified type name with .
目标类型名。与 配合时使用完整类型名；与 配合时使用程序集限定类型名。

param.name: name
param.para: Remote member name when it differs from the stub member.
与存根成员名称不同时使用的远端成员名。

仅覆盖远端成员名；类型来自外层互操作特性或包装器上下文。

param.name: name
param.para: Remote member name when it differs from the stub member.

将声明的成员排除在互操作绑定之外。被忽略的属性保留两个访问器，方法保留原实现； 标注任一访问器会排除整个属性。其他成员照常处理。
Built-in contributor that processes stubs marked with or .
处理带有 或 标记之存根的内置贡献器。
Extensible post-mod-load type-discovery pipeline invoked during early localization initialization. It mirrors BaseLib's scan timing without coupling discovery to one feature.
在本地化初始化早期调用的可扩展模组加载后类型发现管线。它与 BaseLib 的扫描时机保持一致， 但不会将发现流程绑定到单一功能。

Registers a discovery contributor. Custom contributors must be registered from the mod initializer before the discovery pipeline runs; registers built-ins. Built-in interop binding completes across all assemblies before saved-state initialization and attribute registration. Custom contributors then run in registration order, each over all types.
注册类型发现贡献器。自定义贡献器必须在类型发现管线运行前由模组初始化器注册； 内置贡献器由 注册。 内置互操作绑定会先覆盖所有程序集，再进行持久化状态初始化与特性注册。 随后按注册顺序运行自定义贡献器，每个贡献器遍历全部类型。

Associates an assembly with a mod for the one-shot discovery pipeline. Call it from the mod initializer before runs. Auto-registration uses this ID before the manifest ID unless the registration's declaring type specifies . Repeating the same association has no effect. Existing game assembly ownership is preserved.
为一次性类型发现管线建立程序集与模组的关联。请在模组初始化器中、且在 运行前调用。自动注册优先使用此 ID，而非清单 ID； 注册特性声明类型上的 优先级更高。 重复建立相同关联没有效果，游戏已有的程序集归属保持不变。

param.para: Assembly to scan; each assembly can have one registered owner.
待扫描的程序集；每个程序集只能注册一个归属。

Gets the deterministic value minted for this keyword above the native enum range. The value is stored directly in CardModel.Keywords, allowing native lookup, cloning, canonical seeding, and run-save paths to carry the keyword without parallel state. populates it during registration; definitions created outside the registry retain .
获取为此关键词确定性生成且位于原版枚举范围以上的 值。该值直接存入 CardModel.Keywords，因此原版查询、克隆、初始关键词填充和单局存档流程均可携带该关键词， 无需维护并行状态。 会在注册时填充此值；在注册表外创建的定义 保持为 。

Hooks and related initialization to freeze registries, inject models, and publish model lifecycle events.
挂接 及相关初始化过程，以冻结注册表、注入模型并发布模型生命周期事件。
Checks the base-game mod-type cache after mods load, before other mods such as BaseLib consume . Subsequent checks retain it while static assemblies are unchanged.
在模组加载后、BaseLib 等其他模组使用 前检查原版类型缓存。 后续检查会在静态程序集未变化时保留缓存。
Publishes and for .
为 发布 和 。

通过 发布 和 。

发布 ，并将一局游戏结束转发给 。
Publishes a lifecycle event when is created from run state and save data.
当使用局内状态和存档数据创建 时发布生命周期事件。
Blocks multiplayer StartRun when a player references an unregistered character, preserving the save; otherwise, leaves the base-game load flow unchanged.
当一名玩家引用未注册角色时阻止多人游戏的 StartRun，同时保留存档； 其他情况下不改变原版游戏的加载流程。
Blocks Custom Mode StartRun when a player references an unregistered character, preserving the save; otherwise, leaves the base-game load flow unchanged.
当一名玩家引用未注册角色时阻止自定义模式的 StartRun，同时保留存档； 其他情况下不改变原版游戏的加载流程。
Blocks Daily Climb StartRun when a player references an unregistered character, preserving the save; otherwise, leaves the base-game load flow unchanged.
当一名玩家引用未注册角色时阻止每日攀登的 StartRun，同时保留存档； 其他情况下不改变原版游戏的加载流程。
Converts missing Act or character models encountered by into the same error state used for an unreadable save.
将 遇到的章节或角色模型缺失错误转换为与存档无法读取时相同的错误状态。
Rejects saves that reference unregistered characters before OnContinueButtonPressedAsync reaches RunState.FromSerializable, without changing the normal base-game continuation flow.
在 OnContinueButtonPressedAsync 调用 RunState.FromSerializable 前拒绝引用未注册角色的存档， 且不改变原版游戏的正常继续流程。
Defers publication of the shared main-menu lifecycle event until the main menu node is ready.
主菜单节点就绪后，延迟发布共享的主菜单生命周期事件。
Replaces the multiplayer test's fixed base-game character list with so registered mod characters appear in its paginator.
将多人测试中固定的原版角色列表替换为 ， 使已注册的模组角色显示在分页列表中。
Lets the user preview a dropped .run or .save file on the base-game Run History screen without importing it into the saved run-history list.
允许用户在原版游戏的游戏历史界面中预览拖入的 .run 或 .save 文件， 而不将其导入已保存的历史记录列表。
在 处理跑局历史加载失败后抑制重新抛出。该异常会经由 TaskHelper.RunSafely 传播并可能冻结输入；在原版处理后吞掉它可使菜单保持可用。
Publishes lifecycle events for Gold gains, potion acquisition or removal, and claimed rewards.
发布获得金币、获取或移除药水以及领取奖励的生命周期事件。
Publishes a lifecycle event when a player loses Gold through .
当一名玩家通过 失去金币时发布生命周期事件。
Publishes a lifecycle event when a relic is obtained through .
当通过 获得遗物时发布生命周期事件。
Publishes a lifecycle event when a relic is removed through .
当通过 移除遗物时发布生命周期事件。
Publishes lifecycle events before and after a room's entry logic.
在房间进入逻辑执行前后发布生命周期事件。
Publishes an Act-entered lifecycle event after completes.
在 完成后发布章节已进入生命周期事件。
Publishes after the hook task completes.
在钩子任务完成后发布 。
Publishes a room-exited lifecycle event after exits the current room.
在 退出当前房间后发布房间已退出生命周期事件。
Publishes Act-entering and final Rewards-screen continuation events from .
从 发布章节进入中事件以及最终奖励界面的继续事件。
Redirects character and Act lookups on the Run History UI to , allowing history from unavailable mods to use deprecated-model placeholders.
将游戏历史界面中的角色与章节查找重定向到 ， 使来自当前不可用模组的历史记录可使用已弃用模型占位项。
Redirects supported ModelDb.GetById calls to RitsuLib fallbacks.
将受支持的 ModelDb.GetById 调用重定向到 RitsuLib 回退实现。
Publishes lifecycle events around profile initialization, switching, progress saving, and profile deletion.
围绕 的档案初始化、切换、进度保存和档案删除操作发布生命周期事件。
Publishes lifecycle events when saves the current run.
当 保存当前一局游戏时发布生命周期事件。
Publishes Epoch acquisition and reveal lifecycle events from .
从 发布纪元获得与显示生命周期事件。
Publishes a lifecycle event after the legacy unlock counter advances or, on game API 0.110.0 and later, after the save manager attempts to grant the next score-based epoch.
在旧版解锁计数推进后发布生命周期事件；从游戏 API 0.110.0 起，则在存档管理器尝试授予 下一个基于分数的纪元后发布。

Loads ancient-event dialogue lines from localization tables and adds them to AncientDialogueSet instances for modded characters.

为先古之民事件和角色条目 ID 构建 {ancient}.talk.{character}. 本地化键前缀。
Reads the contiguous, zero-based dialogue sequences for an ancient event and character from the ancients localization table.
从 ancients 本地化表读取指定先古之民事件和角色从零开始、连续编号的对话序列。
Reads dialogue sequences under from . Sequence and line indices must each be contiguous and start at zero; scanning stops at the first missing index.
从 读取 下的对话序列。序列索引和行索引均须从零开始且连续；遇到首个缺失索引时即停止扫描。

Builds an for a modded ancient event from the ancients localization table. It reads the first {id}.talk.firstVisitEver.* sequence, all {id}.talk.ANY.* sequences, and sequences for each base-game character.
根据 ancients 本地化表为模组先古之民事件构建 。该方法读取首个 {id}.talk.firstVisitEver.* 序列、全部 {id}.talk.ANY.* 序列，以及每个原版角色的对话序列。

remarks.para: Characters registered in are intentionally omitted. RitsuLib's PopulateLocKeys prefix adds their entries once through .
此处会有意跳过在 中注册的角色；RitsuLib 的 PopulateLocKeys 前置补丁会通过 添加一次这些角色的条目。

summary.para: Fills missing dialogue indices for in for from localization. Existing entries retain their indices and instances; only the localized suffix beyond the current list count is appended. Repeated calls and repeated characters do not append the same indices again.
使用本地化数据补齐 中 在 下缺失的对话索引。保留已有条目的索引和实例，仅追加超出当前列表长度的 本地化对话；重复调用或重复传入角色不会再次追加相同索引。

returns.para: The number of AncientDialogue instances appended.
追加的 AncientDialogue 实例数。

summary.para: Emits at most one warning for each missing ancient-event dialogue key while allowing the current run to continue.
先古之民事件对话键缺失但当前局内流程仍需继续时，每个键至多发出一次警告。

注册虚拟本地化表 ID，使 RitsuLib 的 字典可通过游戏的 LocString 和 LocTable 管线访问。
Builds a virtual localization-table ID in the standard MODID_I18N_STEM form.
按标准的 MODID_I18N_STEM 形式构建虚拟本地化表 ID。
Registers as the translation source for the virtual table ID MODID_I18N_STEM.
将 注册为虚拟表 ID MODID_I18N_STEM 的翻译来源。

returns.para: if the table was registered or replaced; if the ID already existed and was .
成功注册或替换表时为 ；ID 已存在且 为 时为 。

remarks.para: The bridge owns a localization snapshot outside the game's table collection. It refreshes that snapshot after and unregisters it when is disposed.
桥接在游戏表集合之外持有本地化快照； 触发后会刷新快照，且 释放时会自动注销。

exception.para: has already been disposed.
已被释放。

summary.para: Unregisters a virtual table ID previously registered through .
注销先前通过 注册的虚拟表 ID。

returns.para: if the table was removed; otherwise, .
成功移除表时为 ；否则为 。

summary.para: Adds localization-defined ancient-event dialogue for registered modded characters before AncientDialogueSet.PopulateLocKeys runs.
在 AncientDialogueSet.PopulateLocKeys 运行前，为已注册的模组角色添加由本地化定义的先古之民事件对话。
Resolves registered virtual I18N tables through LocManager.GetTable.
使 LocManager.GetTable 能够解析已注册的虚拟 I18N 表。
Resolves virtual I18N entries at the LocString.GetRawText boundary so an inlined LocManager.GetTable cannot bypass the bridge.
在 LocString.GetRawText 边界解析虚拟 I18N 条目，防止内联的 LocManager.GetTable 绕过桥接。
Resolves static LocString.Exists queries for virtual I18N tables.
解析虚拟 I18N 表的静态 LocString.Exists 查询。
Resolves instance LocString.Exists queries for virtual I18N tables.
解析虚拟 I18N 表的实例 LocString.Exists 查询。
Resolves random prefix selection for virtual I18N tables.
解析虚拟 I18N 表的随机前缀选择。
Injects mod-registered SmartFormat extensions after the game creates its localization formatter.
在游戏创建本地化格式化器后，注入模组注册的 SmartFormat 扩展。

When localization-table debug compatibility is enabled, makes LocTable.GetLocString return a key-preserving placeholder for missing entries and logs one [Localization][DebugCompat] warning per table, key, and method. Otherwise, the base game's throw-on-missing behavior is unchanged.
启用本地化表调试兼容时，使 LocTable.GetLocString 为缺失条目返回保留原键的占位值，并按表、键和方法各记录一次 [Localization][DebugCompat] 警告；否则保留原版缺失即抛异常的行为。

When localization-table debug compatibility is enabled, makes LocTable.GetRawText return the raw key for missing entries and logs one [Localization][DebugCompat] warning per table, key, and method. Otherwise, the base game's throw-on-missing behavior is unchanged.
启用本地化表调试兼容时，使 LocTable.GetRawText 为缺失条目返回原始键，并按表、键和方法各记录一次 [Localization][DebugCompat] 警告；否则保留原版缺失即抛异常的行为。
Prevents THE_ARCHITECT's WinRun path from dereferencing a null dialogue when no can be resolved for a registered modded character.

The fallback dialogue has an empty collection, preserving the base game's no-dialogue options and UI path while providing an EndAttackers value for WinRun. A non-empty uninitialized dialogue would instead leave the room without buttons.

This patch applies only when both the debug-compatibility master switch and the Ancient/THE_ARCHITECT compatibility setting are enabled. Otherwise, the base-game behavior, including a possible null-reference exception after PROCEED, remains unchanged.
当已注册的模组角色无法解析出 时，避免 THE_ARCHITECT 的 WinRun 流程解引用空对话。
回退对话的 集合为空，因此既能保留原版无对话时的选项和界面流程，又能为 WinRun 提供 EndAttackers 值。若使用包含未初始化台词的非空对话，房间反而会没有可用按钮。
此补丁仅在调试兼容总开关和 Ancient/THE_ARCHITECT 兼容设置同时启用时生效；否则保留原版行为，包括选择 PROCEED 后可能发生的空引用异常。

Registers and dispatches bounded, versioned extension payloads appended to vanilla network messages.

remarks.para: Registrations are process-wide and case-sensitive per message type. Each extension ID may be registered only once, with at most 64 registrations per message type. Registrations remain active for the process lifetime. The owner of a message's serialization patches must call and exactly once after the vanilla body; other mods extending the same message should only register their entries. Patch a stable outer serialization boundary: small message Serialize and Deserialize methods may be inlined before Harmony can intercept them.
注册在进程内按消息类型共享，扩展 ID 区分大小写且只能注册一次，每种消息类型最多注册 64 个扩展， 并在当前进程的生命周期内持续有效。消息序列化补丁的所有者必须在原版消息体之后各调用一次 与 ；扩展同一消息的其他模组只应注册 各自条目。补丁应放在稳定的外层序列化边界；较短的消息 Serialize 与 Deserialize 方法可能在 Harmony 拦截前被内联。

remarks.para: Call this exactly once for each serialized message. Payload writers run synchronously in ordinal ID order. Recoverable writer failures and payloads over 4 MiB are logged and omitted. If the complete tail exceeds 8 MiB, it is logged and entirely omitted. Non-recoverable exceptions propagate.

summary.para: Defines a backend-independent delivery contract for routed endpoint messages.
定义路由端点消息使用的后端无关投递契约。
Reliable, ordered delivery for bounded control messages. Accepted sends remain subject to disconnects and do not constitute an application-level acknowledgement.
为有界控制消息提供可靠且有序的投递。发送被接受并不构成应用层确认，断线仍可能使消息无法到达。

Unreliable, sequenced delivery for latency-sensitive datagrams. RitsuLib drops expired queued frames and stale received sequence numbers; messages are never fragmented or retransmitted by the data plane.
为延迟敏感的数据报提供不可靠、带序列的投递。RitsuLib 会丢弃队列中过期的帧和收到的旧序列号； 数据平面绝不会分片或重传此类消息。

Reliable, windowed delivery for bounded byte streams such as images, files, and large snapshots. Streams use application acknowledgements, bounded retransmission, cancellation, and end-to-end SHA-256 verification. Register this profile through .
为图片、文件和大型快照等有界字节流提供可靠的窗口式投递。流使用应用层确认、有界重传、取消和 端到端 SHA-256 校验。此档位应通过 注册。
Defines who may participate in and route messages for an endpoint.
定义哪些参与方可以加入端点并为其路由消息。

The host must register the endpoint. Clients may send only to the host; the host may send to compatible clients individually or by broadcast. RitsuLib never relays a client-originated opaque payload to another client.
主机必须注册该端点。客户端只能向主机发送；主机可以单独或广播发送给兼容客户端。RitsuLib 绝不会把源自客户端的不透明载荷中继给其他客户端。
The host may route opaque payloads between compatible participants without registering or understanding the endpoint itself.
主机可以在兼容参与方之间路由不透明载荷，而无需自行注册或理解该端点。
Defines where an endpoint receive callback executes.
定义端点接收回调的执行位置。

Queue callbacks on the Godot main loop. This is the default and required for callbacks that access scene-tree or game state. The per-endpoint callback queue is bounded; excess deliveries are dropped and logged.
将回调排入 Godot 主循环。这是默认选项；访问场景树或游戏状态的回调必须使用此模式。 每个端点的回调队列有界；超出容量的投递会被丢弃并记录日志。
Execute synchronously on the transport receive callback. The callback must not block or access thread-affine game state.
在传输接收回调上同步执行。回调不得阻塞，也不得访问具有线程关联的游戏状态。
Execute on a bounded, endpoint-owned serial background queue that preserves callback order. Excess deliveries are dropped and logged.
在端点独占的有界串行后台队列中执行，并保持回调顺序；超出容量的投递会被丢弃并记录日志。

请求的操作不适用于该端点拓扑或本地角色。

在原版网络反序列化前检查并分发收到的 sidecar 数据包和合并数据包。

将大型用户载荷拆分为带 CRC 校验的分块帧，并保留这些帧以供选择性重传。

remarks.para: This compatibility API is obsolete. New file, image, and large-snapshot transfers must use , which adds negotiation, bounded streaming, backpressure, cancellation, end-to-end integrity, and lifecycle handling.
此兼容接口已过时。新的文件、图片和大型快照传输必须使用 ；新接口提供协商、有界流式处理、背压、取消、 端到端完整性校验和生命周期处理。

Frames are fully constructed and registered for retransmission before the first transport attempt. If the first attempt fails, its outbound state is removed. A later failed attempt stops the remaining sends while retaining the state for frames that may already have reached the peer.
会在首次传输尝试前完整构造帧并注册重传状态。首次尝试失败时会移除其出站状态；之后的尝试失败时， 会停止发送剩余帧，但保留已可能到达对等方的帧的重传状态。

在接受分段或完成重组后同步发生。订阅者失败会被记录，且不会阻止后续订阅者或传输完成路径。

扩展中关联 ID 的大小。

读取关联 ID 所需的完整标头扩展最小长度。

为请求与回复的匹配分配一个进程内单调递增的关联 ID。
Writes in big-endian order to the first 8 bytes of .
将 以大端序写入 的前 8 字节。

为 构建附加标头扩展：先写入 8 字节大端序关联 ID， 再写入 。

向 追加大端序关联 ID 和尾随字节。

当标头扩展包含关联 ID 时返回 。

编解码 和 载荷。

握手载荷的长度，其中包含请求版本、支持的最高版本和功能标志；多字节值采用大端序。
The acknowledgement payload length, including the selected version, acceptance byte, and sender feature flags.
握手确认载荷的长度，其中包含选定版本、接受状态字节和发送方功能标志。

将握手载荷写入 ；其长度不得小于 字节。

通过哈希 modId + U+0000 + messageKind 的 UTF-8 字节，为模组消息类型返回稳定操作码。 载荷契约发生变化时，应同时更改 。

定义通过 握手声明的功能标志。

remarks.para: This fixed-width set remains the compatibility contract for established handshake-era services. New routed data services advertise self-describing endpoint catalogs instead of allocating additional bits. Existing values remain readable and writable during the migration window.
此固定宽度集合继续作为既有握手时代服务的兼容契约。新的路由数据服务通过自描述端点目录声明能力， 不再分配新的标志位；迁移期内既有值仍可读写。

不声明任何可选功能。

支持重组通过 消息发送的大型载荷。

等待原版消息缓冲区或位置缓冲区时，最多保留的 sidecar 同步消息数。

sidecar 同步缓冲区最多保留的逻辑载荷总字节数。

所有发送方合计最多保留的未完成分块流数。

单个发送方最多保留的未完成分块流数。

单个分块流最多接受的分段数。

所有发送方的未完成分块流最多预留的逻辑载荷总字节数。
The maximum total logical payload size reserved by incomplete chunk streams for one sender.
单个发送方的未完成分块流最多预留的逻辑载荷总字节数。

定义为框架控制消息保留的固定操作码。 返回的操作码始终位于 保留范围之外。
Reserved for an optional framework keepalive or latency probe.
保留用于可选的框架保活或延迟探测。
Advertises capabilities and initiates wire-version negotiation.
声明功能并发起线路格式版本协商。

确认 ，并报告协商后的版本和响应方功能。

承载分块逻辑载荷中的一个分段。

向原分块流发送方报告缺失分段的变长范围列表。
Confirms reassembly to the original chunk-stream sender so it can discard the retained outbound frames.
向原分块流发送方确认重组完成，使其可以丢弃保留的待发送帧。
Requests that the host coordinate a combat-state diagnostic dump across all peers.
请求主机协调所有对等端生成战斗状态诊断转储。
Carries from the host so each peer records its local state.
由主机发送 ，使每个对等端记录本地状态。

向主机承载对等方完整的路由端点能力目录。

向一个客户端承载由主机确定的路由端点快照。

确认已原子应用一份路由端点快照。
Carries client endpoint data to the host for validation and optional relay.
将客户端端点数据送往主机，以便验证并按需中继。
Carries host-originated or host-relayed endpoint data with a host-assigned canonical sender identity.
承载主机发起或主机中继的端点数据，并包含由主机确定的规范发送方身份。
Specifies how a sidecar payload is transported and, by convention, interpreted. When present, the first byte of the envelope header extension stores this value.
指定 sidecar 载荷的传输方式及其约定语义。信封标头扩展存在投递标签时，其首字节存储此值。
Uses unreliable transport on the best-effort channel. Frames may be lost or reordered, and handlers may run as soon as a frame arrives.

Gets the stable caller identifier used to isolate duplicate suppression and recovery journals. remarks.para: Arguments are validated and the array is copied immediately, so later caller mutations do not affect the queued rule. Apply before content freezes; no ordinary pool declaration is required. Registration occurs when the queued step is applied. Repeated calls create independent rules. Priority, callback timing, process lifetime and selection follow .
立即验证参数并复制数组，调用方后续修改不会影响已排队的规则。 必须在内容冻结前应用，无须声明普通池。应用队列步骤时才会注册，重复调用会创建独立规则。 优先级、回调时机、进程生命周期与抽选规则见 。

summary.para: Defines a runtime combat factory for creature models whose calls should be handled by . It supports Spine and non-Spine animation backends.
为生物模型定义运行时战斗 工厂，使其 调用可由 处理。该工厂支持 Spine 和非 Spine 动画后端。

remarks.para:
Typical implementers subclass
or , but the templates are convenience. The contract is opt-in via the interface itself: any model type implementing this interface is routed through — template subclassing is not required.
receives the same trigger names that vanilla would dispatch to a Spine animator (Idle, Attack, Cast, Hit, Dead, Revive, and others).

When this factory returns non-null for a Spine-backed creature, the routing patch consumes before the vanilla _spineAnimator path runs; keep in sync for Revive if you rely on vanilla gating, or rely on the RitsuLib revive postfix when the animator does not declare Revive.

常见实现会继承 或 ，但模板只是便利封装。该接口采用显式选择加入的方式： 任何实现此接口的模型类型都会由
路由，无需继承模板。
接收与原版分派给 Spine 动画器相同的触发器名称， 包括 Idle、Attack、Cast、Hit、Dead 和 Revive 等。
当此工厂为使用 Spine 后端的生物返回非空状态机时，路由补丁会先处理 ，不再进入原版 _spineAnimator 路径。 若依赖原版 的条件判断，请让 正确报告 Revive； 动画器未声明 Revive 时，也可依赖 RitsuLib 的复活后置补丁。

Refreshes every category currently supported by the runtime coordinator.

Accepts refresh requests from any thread and coalesces them for the next main-thread frame. Filtered requests in a category are combined with OR; an unrestricted request overrides those filters. Predicates run on the main thread. Recoverable predicate or node-refresh failures are logged without stopping the remaining refreshes.
接受任意线程发出的刷新请求，并合并到主线程的下一帧。同一类别的条件按“或”组合， 整类刷新优先于这些条件。条件回调在主线程执行；条件或节点刷新中的可恢复异常会记录到日志， 不会阻止其余刷新。

Requests a deferred main-thread refresh for every live, ready node in the specified categories. An unrestricted category takes precedence over filtered requests in the same pending batch. Requests made during a refresh are processed on a later frame.

Queues optional slot and unlock configuration, then registers in this story column. For epochs, register a timeline layout before the timeline freezes, normally through ; conflicts with base-game layout are reported during application. Operations run in call order, and a later epoch requirement for the same model replaces an earlier one.

remarks.para:
You can call these methods multiple times inside one epoch slot; they run in order. A later RequireEpoch for the same model replaces the earlier epoch binding. Content registered through is gated by / . Integrations include , , , , , and .
Cards · gate an entire pool behind this epoch: RequireAllCardsInPool<TCardPool>() (only ; does not register ).
Cards · explicit list + pack-declared unlock UI: Cards(types); whole pool into the registry: CardsFromPool<TCardPool>().
Relics · whole pool: RequireAllRelicsInPool<TRelicPool>().
Relics · explicit types or pool + registry: Relics(types), RelicsFromPool<TRelicPool>().
Potions · whole pool: RequireAllPotionsInPool<TPotionPool>() (RequireEpoch only; does not register ).
Potions · explicit types: Potions(types). For timeline potion presentation, subclass for your and implement PotionTypes; keep those CLR types aligned with Potions / RequireEpoch (this method already applies RequireEpoch).

可以在一个纪元槽位内多次调用这些方法；它们会按顺序运行。后续针对同一模型的 RequireEpoch 会替换较早的纪元绑定。 通过 注册的内容，会受到 / 门控。集成点包括 、、 、、 和 。
卡牌 · 将整个池门控在此纪元之后：RequireAllCardsInPool<TCardPool>()（仅注册 ；不会注册 ）。
卡牌 · 显式列表加包声明的解锁界面：Cards(types)；将整个池加入注册表： CardsFromPool<TCardPool>()。
遗物 · 整个池：RequireAllRelicsInPool<TRelicPool>()。
遗物 · 显式类型或池加注册表：Relics(types)、 RelicsFromPool<TRelicPool>()。
药水 · 整个池：RequireAllPotionsInPool<TPotionPool>()（仅应用 RequireEpoch； 不注册 ）。
药水 · 显式类型：Potions(types)。如需时间线药水表现，请为你的 派生 并实现 PotionTypes；保持这些 CLR 类型与 Potions / RequireEpoch 对齐（此方法已 应用 RequireEpoch）。

创建禁用的适配器，并提供向用户显示的原因。
Sends telemetry batches as JSON over HTTP to a self-hosted mod endpoint.
通过 HTTP 将遥测批次以 JSON 格式发送到模组自行托管的端点。
Creates an adapter that sends batches to with HTTP POST requests.
创建通过 HTTP POST 请求向 发送批次的适配器。
Gets the absolute endpoint URI that receives telemetry batches.
获取接收遥测批次的绝对端点 URI。

remarks.para: Batches larger than 4 MiB of UTF-8 JSON fail without an HTTP request. Queued delivery splits oversized batches and discards a single event that cannot fit.
UTF-8 JSON 超过 4 MiB 的批次会直接失败，不发起 HTTP 请求。队列投递会拆分过大的批次，并丢弃仍无法容纳的单个事件。

summary.para: Sends one applicant's authorized telemetry events to that applicant's fixed backend.

Gets optional source data available before payload generation. Filters must treat it as borrowed, read-only data and must not retain it after returning. For godot_engine_error events from godot_logger, this is a containing type, message, code, function, file, line, script_backtrace, timestamp_utc and truncated fields. Local absolute paths are redacted; resource and node paths are retained. The script backtrace may be empty. Filters run on the main thread. Type is the integer Godot logger error type. Message, code, function, file and backtrace are limited to 4096, 2048, 512, 1024 and 8192 characters respectively. Automatic engine capture is best-effort: the most recent 128 admitted fingerprints are retained in FIFO order without time-based expiry, with up to 20 admitted errors per minute and 64 pending errors.

获取负载生成前可用的可选来源数据。筛选器必须将其视为借用的只读数据，且不得在返回后继续 持有它。 来源为 godot_logger 的 godot_engine_error 事件提供 ，包含 type、message、code、function、file、line、 script_backtrace、timestamp_utc 及 truncated 字段。本机绝对路径会脱敏，资源与节点路径会保留； 脚本堆栈可能为空。此类事件的筛选器在主线程运行。 type 是 Godot 日志错误类型的整数值。message、code、function、file 和堆栈分别限制为 4096、2048、512、1024 和 8192 个字符。引擎错误自动采集不保证完整：按先进先出顺序保留最近 128 项获准采集的指纹，不按时间过期；每分钟最多采集 20 项错误，最多保留 64 项待处理错误。

summary.para: Bootstraps RitsuLib's built-in telemetry applicant and runtime hooks.
引导初始化 RitsuLib 内置的遥测申请方和运行时钩子。
Attaches telemetry runtime callbacks. Registration of the user-visible applicant is deferred until the first main menu.
挂接遥测运行时回调。向用户显示的申请方会延迟到首次进入主菜单时注册。
Shows the telemetry consent notification on the first main menu and starts delivery of authorized startup data.
首次进入主菜单时显示遥测授权通知，并开始投递已获授权的启动数据。
Runs the first-main-menu flow at most once per process.
每个进程最多运行一次首次主菜单流程。
Registers the single-page telemetry permission manager.
注册单页遥测权限管理界面。
Ensures that the telemetry settings page is registered.
确保遥测设置页面已注册。
Re-registers the telemetry settings page after an applicant is registered.
注册申请方后重新注册遥测设置页面。

Maps epoch IDs to card and relic CLR types gated by those epochs. Content-pack flows such as populate the registry, and pack-declared unlock epoch templates consume it. Potion gating is registered directly with .
将纪元 ID 映射到受其限制的卡牌和遗物 CLR 类型。 等内容包流程 会填充此注册表，再由内容包声明的解锁纪元模板使用。药水的纪元限制则直接通过 注册。
Gets whether registration has been frozen.
获取注册是否已被冻结。
Registers the model types gated by the unique . At least one card or relic type is required.
注册受唯一 限制的模型类型。必须至少提供一个卡牌或遗物类型。
Returns whether a content pack registered gated types for .
返回内容包是否为 注册了受限类型。
Resolves the instances gated by an epoch ID.
解析受指定纪元 ID 限制的 实例。
Resolves the instances gated by an epoch ID.
解析受指定纪元 ID 限制的 实例。
Contains a snapshot of the types registered for one epoch by its owning mod.
包含所属模组为一个纪元注册的类型快照。
Contains a snapshot of the types registered for one epoch by its owning mod.
包含所属模组为一个纪元注册的类型快照。
Collects ordered epoch CLR types for each concrete type. adds entries, and reads them instead of using a hard-coded type list.
为每个具体 类型收集有序的纪元 CLR 类型。 会添加条目， 则读取这些条目，而非使用硬编码的类型列表。
Appends to 's column in registration order.
按注册顺序将 追加到 的列中。

exception.para: Registration is frozen, the epoch is already present in this story, or the epoch belongs to another story.
注册已被冻结、该纪元已存在于此故事中，或该纪元已属于另一个故事。

summary.para: Returns the ordered epoch types for a concrete story type, or an empty list when none are bound.
返回具体故事类型的有序纪元类型；没有绑定时返回空列表。
Registers timeline-axis icon policies by era.
按时代注册时间线坐标轴图标策略。
Configures the icon policy for an value.
为 值配置图标策略。
Configures the icon policy for an era's integer value, including custom values absent from the enum.
为时代的整数值配置图标策略，也支持未在枚举中定义的自定义值。
Clears the icon policy for an value.
清除 值的图标策略。
Clears the icon policy for an era's integer value.
清除时代整数值的图标策略。
Registers the column and EraPosition used to place each . Base-game instances reserve their cells first, preventing mod slots from silently overlapping them.
注册各 在时间线中使用的 列和列内 EraPosition。游戏本体的 实例会先占用其格位，避免模组槽位与之静默重叠。
Lower bound for scans that place a column before an anchor era.
在锚点时代之前放置列时所用的扫描下限。
Upper bound for scans that place a column after an anchor era.
在锚点时代之后放置列时所用的扫描上限。
Registers an explicit slot, throwing if the cell is occupied by the base game or another mod registration.
注册显式槽位；若该格位已被游戏本体或其他模组注册占用，则抛出异常。
Registers the lowest nonnegative EraPosition in that is not occupied by the base game or an earlier mod registration.
在 中注册未被游戏本体或先前模组注册占用的最小非负 EraPosition。

Places the epoch in the nearest available column before by integer order. Position zero in each candidate column is preferred; if every candidate root is occupied, the nearest column with any free position is used.
按整数顺序将纪元放入 之前最近的可用列。会优先检查各候选列的位置 0；若所有候选列的根位置均被占用，则使用最近且仍有其他空位的列。
Behaves like , using the reference epoch's as the anchor.
行为与 相同，但使用参考纪元的 作为锚点。

Places the epoch in the nearest available column after by integer order. Position zero in each candidate column is preferred; if every candidate root is occupied, the nearest column with any free position is used.
按整数顺序将纪元放入 之后最近的可用列。会优先检查各候选列的位置 0；若所有候选列的根位置均被占用，则使用最近且仍有其他空位的列。
Places the epoch after the of .
将纪元放在 的 之后。
Places the epoch in 's column at its first free position.
将纪元放入 所在列的第一个空位。
Places the epoch in the reference epoch's era column at its first free position.
将纪元放入参考纪元所在时代列的第一个空位。
Claims the first free slot in . When is , only position zero is considered.
占用 中的第一个空闲槽位。 为 时只检查位置 0。

Returns whether Neow's primary base-game expansion has begun writing slots to progression data, as indicated by . This prevents a cold-open timeline from displaying every mod story column before the expansion.
根据 判断涅奥的游戏本体主扩展是否已开始将槽位写入进度数据。 这可避免在扩展发生前首次打开时间线时便显示所有模组故事列。
Handles the postfix of . When initiated the primary expansion, it unlocks slots for eligible mod epochs and schedules their animated merge.
处理 的后置补丁。当主扩展由 发起时，为符合条件的模组纪元解锁槽位，并安排其动画合并。
Adds a mod's custom and types to the game's timeline dictionaries. An epoch represents one unlock slot; a story groups ordered epochs under one progression column.
将模组自定义的 和 类型加入游戏的时间线字典。 一个纪元表示一个解锁槽位；一个故事会将有序纪元归入同一进度列。
Gets whether the framework has frozen further epoch and story registration.
获取框架是否已冻结后续纪元与故事注册。
Returns the timeline registry for .
返回 对应的时间线注册表。
Registers a concrete epoch type with the game's epoch discovery.
向游戏的纪元发现机制注册具体纪元类型。
Registers with the game's epoch discovery.
向游戏的纪元发现机制注册 。
Registers a concrete story type in the game's story-type dictionary.
向游戏的故事类型字典注册具体故事类型。

向游戏的故事类型字典注册 。
Registers with the game's epoch discovery and appends it to 's ordered column through .
向游戏的纪元发现机制注册 ，并通过 将其追加到 的有序列。
Registers and binds it to 's story column.
注册 ，并将其绑定到 的故事列。
Rebuilds from the live _epochTypeDictionary, keeping consistent with after third-party dictionary edits or early initialization of the base-game ID cache.
根据实时 _epochTypeDictionary 重建 ，使第三方修改字典或 游戏本体过早初始化 ID 缓存后， 仍与 保持一致。
Limits mod timeline co-expansion to , preventing unrelated calls from unlocking or animating every .
将模组时间线的共同扩展限制在 流程内，避免无关的 调用解锁或播放所有 的动画。

Merges eligible mod epoch slots into NTimelineScreen.AddEpochSlots. On a nonanimated screen open, merging begins only after Neow's primary expansion has started. During an animated expansion, merging occurs only for the batch queued by .
将符合条件的模组纪元槽位合并到 NTimelineScreen.AddEpochSlots。非动画方式打开界面时，仅在涅奥的 主扩展开始后合并；播放扩展动画时，则只合并由 入队的批次。
Applies timeline-axis icon policies, hiding a custom era's icon by default when no texture is available.
应用时间线坐标轴图标策略；自定义时代没有可用纹理时，默认隐藏其图标。
Hides an era icon node when no texture was resolved.
未解析出纹理时隐藏时代图标节点。

Synchronizes with the live epoch-type dictionary before timeline expansion queues slots. This prevents progression filtering from discarding newly registered mod epoch IDs immediately after their slots are unlocked.
在时间线扩展将槽位入队前，使 与实时纪元类型字典同步，防止进度筛选在 新注册的模组纪元槽位刚解锁后便丢弃其 ID。
Sorts timeline expansion slots by and then , avoiding collisions between equal positions in different eras.
先按 、再按 对时间线扩展槽位排序， 避免不同时代中相同位置发生排序冲突。
Extends Neow's primary timeline expansion with eligible mod character roots and other mod epoch slots, then signals the animated timeline screen to merge those slots in the current session.
将符合条件的模组角色根节点和其他模组纪元槽位加入涅奥的主时间线扩展，并通知动画时间线界面在当前会话中 合并这些槽位。

Invoked when the button is released, after its click animation starts.
按钮释放且点击动画开始后调用。
Returns whether the button should be visible. This method runs during _Process and should remain inexpensive. The default is .
返回按钮是否应当可见。此方法会在 _Process 中调用，应避免耗时操作。 默认返回 。
Returns whether the associated screen or mode is open. An open button uses the selected-state tilt of vanilla top-bar buttons. This method runs during _Process; the default is .
返回关联界面或模式是否打开。打开的按钮会使用原版顶部栏按钮的选中状态倾斜效果。 此方法会在 _Process 中调用；默认返回 。
Returns the count displayed below the icon. Negative values hide the label. This method runs during _Process; the default is -1.
返回显示在图标下方的数量。负数会隐藏标签。此方法会在 _Process 中调用； 默认值为 -1。
Context passed to top-bar button callbacks. It exposes the registered definition, the local player, the mounted button, and helpers for managing capstone screens.
传给顶部栏按钮回调的上下文。它提供已注册定义、本地玩家、已挂载按钮和管理 Capstone 屏幕的辅助方法。

每次回调都会创建新的上下文。本地玩家尚未绑定时（包括两局游戏之间）， 为 。

请在 创建当前顶部栏前完成注册。 同一模组重复注册同一 ID 时返回已有定义；其他模组不能占用该 ID。

member.name: M:STS2RitsuLib.Ui.MainMenu.NMainMenuScroller.IsPointerOverButton(MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Nodes.Screens.MainMenu.NMainMenuTextButton)
member.summary: Transform-aware hit test for code paths that have no input event at hand (e.g. the mouse mode switch). GetLocalMousePosition() is resolved in the button's local space, so scaled or rotated buttons behave the same way Godot itself hit-tests them. Pairing the canvas-space pointer with GetGlobalRect() instead ignores the button's own scale.

remarks.para: BBCode tag names are global. Repeating a registration returns the existing definition only when the owning mod and effect instance are the same; every other collision fails.
RitsuLib installs registered effects into BBCode-enabled labels when they become ready, after text updates, and after the Godot editor restores scene data following a save.
BBCode 标签名属于全局命名空间。仅当所属模组和特效实例都相同时，重复注册才会返回已有定义； 其他冲突都会失败。
RitsuLib 会在启用 BBCode 的标签进入就绪状态、文本更新后，以及 Godot 编辑器在保存后恢复 场景数据时安装已注册特效。

Applies the game's mid-run epoch restriction without depending on the same helper method being available in every supported build. Nonstandard game modes do not grant epochs.

Adds obtained RitsuLib requirement epochs to before multiplayer lobby synchronization and run setup serialize it.

Deterministically mints 32-bit integer values for string IDs and casts them into . Minted values occupy the reserved high-value band at or above , leaving the low range for vanilla enum members.

remarks.para: Values use ReservedFloor + (XxHash32(utf8(id)) mod (int.MaxValue - ReservedFloor + 1)), so the same ID has a stable value across processes and runs. Recording a distinct ID that collides with an existing one is rejected.
值使用 ReservedFloor + (XxHash32(utf8(id)) mod (int.MaxValue - ReservedFloor + 1)) 计算，因此同一 ID 在不同进程和运行中保持稳定。登记不同 ID 时若与现有 ID 发生哈希碰撞，该操作会被拒绝。
